title: join request (bridge -> server, HTTP)
description: Before the socket, once: the bridge POSTs this JSON (content-type application/json) to the join link https://<host>/join/<code> it was given (Arkab.Bridge.join/2). Answers: 200 with join-response; 404 or 410 code unknown, used or expired; 409 the server does not speak v; 403 with {"error":"elsewhere"} the bridge is still in another hall on that server. Anything else is 'not a server' to the bridge.

bridge.description: The bridge's own id (as in hello).
